audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers gave Vladimir five stages while the packet chart and every whys line say Illaoi owns Levels 2 through 6.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 55.17% over 1238 games. Test of Spirit reaches 900 against Transfusion's 600, and Sanguine Pool is Vladimir's only escape on a 28s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: L1 Vladimir, L2 through Level 6 Illaoi, first item skill, 2+ items Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried no cooldowns, so 'bait his Pool' had no timer attached to it.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and grants 2 seconds of untargetability over a 350 radius — that is the entire punish window, and it shrinks by 12s across its ranks. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s, matching Hemoplague's flat 120s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and spikes[1] rewritten around those numbers; spikes[2] around Vladimir being manaless with a 4.6s rank-5 Transfusion; spikes[3] around Hemoplague's amp and per-champion heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places assert that Sanguine Pool 'does NOT break the tether' — one of them in capitals. Riot's text does not say this, and the kit files cannot confirm it.
audit.why: Test of Spirit breaks on distance or on the spirit dying. Whether a 2-second untargetable pool severs the link is not derivable from the data, and the page states it as certainty a player will bet a full commit on.
audit.corrected: Rewrote around verifiable interactions instead: E 900 outranges Transfusion 600; Harsh Lesson's 4s cooldown means the tentacles resume the moment he surfaces from a 2s pool; Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units per Riot's own text, so standing behind your wave eats it; Vladimir pays health, not mana, for E.

audit.why: The _missing list flags needs-antiheal for this matchup, and report[8] already prescribes Executioner's Calling early. Reinforced it in spikes[3] and late, since Hemoplague heals per champion hit.
suspectNames flagged 'Transfusion' and 'Test of Spirit'. Both are the correct Riot names — two false positives.

edits.before: This is your kill window: land Test of Spirit (E) and Vladimir's Sanguine Pool (W) does NOT break the tether — he can pool the tentacle slaps but the spirit link stays, so W (Harsh Lesson) onto him and he bleeds out. His Transfusion (Q) sustain can't out-heal a full tentacle proc if you hit E first.
edits.after: This is your kill window: Sanguine Pool (W) is down 28s at rank 1 and buys only 2 seconds of untargetability inside a 350 puddle. Land Test of Spirit (E) from 900 — outside his 600 Transfusion — then Harsh Lesson (W) on its 4s cooldown, so the tentacles are swinging again the moment he surfaces.

edits.before: With your R (Leap of Faith) plus a landed E, the tentacle wall punishes his Pool cooldown — he can pool your ult burst once, but if it's down he dies. Force him to Pool early with a fake, then E-W-R the real commit.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R) is 450 range and 120s at rank 1 — the same 120s as his Hemoplague. Bait Pool with a fake step-up, and while those 22 to 28 seconds tick, E, W and R inside your field is the commit he has no answer to.

edits.before: Roughly even: Vladimir hits his Rylai's/Riftmaker spike and his Q sustain plus Pool make him hard to pin, but your tentacles still zone him off CS. Trade only when your E is up, otherwise let him shove and freeze back.
edits.after: Roughly even: he pays no mana, so Transfusion (Q) never dries up on a 4.6s cooldown at rank 5. Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, though — hold your ground behind the wave and it does nothing. Trade only with E up.

edits.before: Vlad flips ahead — his %HP Q and Riftmaker healing let him out-sustain your tentacle damage and Hemoplague (R) amps his team in fights while he pools your ult. Group and rely on locking him with E when he steps up.
edits.after: Vlad flips ahead: Hemoplague (R) makes everyone it marks take extra damage and heals him for every champion it hits, so never clump for it. Keep Grievous Wounds on him all game — his healing, not his burst, is what beats your field.

edits.before: Vladimir wins L1-2: Transfusion (Q) pokes and heals through your early Q chip, and with no E tether yet you can't punish his short cooldown. Farm and take the poke; your spike is coming.
edits.after: Vladimir wins L1: Transfusion (Q) costs no mana and pokes from 600, healing through your Q chip. You cannot punish that before Test of Spirit, so farm, take the chip, and hold for level 2.

edits.before: L3 through 6 is your window. A landed Test of Spirit (E) sticks through Sanguine Pool (W) — he can pool the tentacle slaps but the spirit tether remains, so W-into-tentacles shreds him. Bait his Pool, then E-W and add R (Leap of Faith) for the kill.
edits.after: L2 through 6 is your window. Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 against his 600 Transfusion, and Sanguine Pool is his only escape: 28s at rank 1 for 2 seconds of cover. Bait it, then E, Harsh Lesson the spirit, and add R for the kill.

edits.before: After his first item it evens out on skill — his sustain and Pool make him slippery but your tentacles still zone. Late game Vlad flips ahead: %HP Q, Riftmaker healing, and Hemoplague out-scale your tank damage, so only commit when E is guaranteed.
edits.after: After his first item it evens on skill — Pool keeps him slippery but your tentacles still zone. Late he flips ahead: Hemoplague amps his whole side and heals him for each champion hit, so keep anti-heal up and only commit when E is guaranteed.
